name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Integrated Marketing & Marketing Operations Leader
summary: Marketing leader who runs integrated programs end to end: narrative, campaign, CRM, and the reporting that shows what worked. Fifteen years in B2B SaaS, MarTech, and agency environments on both sides of the marketing and sales handoff, most recently building AI-driven systems that make campaign production repeatable rather than manual. Deep in HubSpot and CRM architecture, with a 30% traffic increase and 25% conversion lift across the e-commerce segment at Wix behind the work.

experience.title: Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Build AI-driven systems that make marketing production repeatable, breaking manual workflows into agent architectures that score a prospect's digital footprint and generate personalized outreach at scale.
Align marketing programs to revenue objectives directly with business owners and sales teams, producing consistent messaging and qualified lead flow.
Architect CRM and marketing automation in HubSpot and GoHighLevel: segmentation, lifecycle stages, lead routing, and data-hygiene standards.

Design and deploy automated lifecycle sequences and nurture programs that activate and retain high-value users, including a 20+ workflow system spanning capture, qualification, booking, no-show recovery, onboarding, and reactivation.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to executive stakeholders.
Develop market-facing content, newsletters, and thought leadership, plus the landing pages and email sequences that carry campaigns to market.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Led integrated marketing strategies across inbound, paid media, and content as strategic lead, coordinating execution across internal departments and agency partners.
Built campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs to stakeholders.
Produced landing pages, complex email sequences, and conversion-focused copy that improved lead generation and pipeline.
Ran Google keyword research and search-term analysis to shape campaign targeting and content direction.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Managed a 15–20 partner portfolio with coordinated account programs and enablement, retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Built scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction across the partner network.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Relayed structured, high-priority customer feedback to Product and Engineering, informing roadmap priorities.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Ran client accounts end to end at a performance marketing agency, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication.
Built internal processes that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment.
Analyzed campaign performance data and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Drove a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Led digital growth consultations aligning site architecture, inbound marketing, and SEO best practices to improve client traffic and conversion.
Managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists, overseeing scope and delivery across a high-value client portfolio.
Built process improvements for a new Wix vertical that grew from proof of concept to a profitable business line, contributing to hiring, onboarding, and training.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Partnered with agencies and professional-services firms on CRM and workflow design, building relationships with C-suite stakeholders as a trusted advisor on operational systems.
Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 for effectively the full tenure, holding that ranking while quota roughly doubled.
Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the delivery team to execute against.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science, Colorado State University
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate, Google / Coursera (2024)
